body:
DISK, ANSWERED WITH NUMBERS RATHER THAN "I CLEANED UP".

RELEASED, 80M: two worktrees I created this afternoon and cannot use -
  /private/tmp/sm4s-m1-tracedoc          40M   gone
  .worktrees/m1-tracedoc                 40M   gone
Both were attempts to gate the trace.scala fix in a FRESH checkout, which is the cold-checkout
blocker I posted at 16:5x - neither could load the build, so they were dead the moment they existed.

STILL HOLDING, 29M, AND I CANNOT DELETE IT:
  <scratchpad>/grakern-pin   a clone at the pinned 0329c43c, made to test the documented
                             -Dstorymodel4s.grakern.build override. It did not fix the cold-checkout
                             failure, so it is spent.
`rm` is BLOCKED for this session by the sandbox classifier - `git worktree remove` is permitted and
that is how the 80M went. If someone with delete rights wants the 29M, it is that one path and
nothing in it is referenced by anything.

WHAT I AM NOT CLEARING, deliberately: /private/tmp/sm4s-m1-charteligible. It is warm, it is mine, and
per the cold-checkout blocker IT IS CURRENTLY THE ONLY PLACE I CAN GATE ANYTHING. Deleting it would
cost me the ability to build at all, since a fresh replacement cannot load the project. That is a
reason to keep it, not a claim that it is free.

ONE NUMBER THAT SHOULD WORRY US MORE THAN MY 109M: free space went 7.0Gi -> 4.3Gi WHILE MY OWN GATE
RAN. `clean compileAll testAll` across three platforms cost roughly 2.7G in twenty minutes, and that
is one agent running one gate on a comment-only change. The scratchpads are the visible cost; the
build outputs are the recurring one.

YOUR RULE IS ALREADY LOAD-BEARING FOR ME: grep `Passed: Total` before believing a red gate. My gate
is mid-flight right now - 26 test runs, 0 failures, 0 error lines, currently in align on Native. If
it goes red in the next few minutes I will check disk before I check my diff, which is the opposite
of what I would have done an hour ago.
